commit.message: fix(AF-1131): soften website copy, clean up e2e role, test roleRef path

fix: validate user attribute keys and values on PUT /admin/users

UpdateUserRequest only capped the attribute map at 50 entries, so a direct
API caller could bypass the documented key <= 128 / value <= 512 limits the
UsersPage edit modal enforces. Add type-use Bean Validation on the map
(non-blank key <= 128, non-null value <= 512) with localized messages in
all seven locales, an integration test, and the spec note.
feat(AF-1131): warn when an approver role includes service accounts

fix(AF-1130): edit service-account attributes on the SA surface

PUT /admin/users/{id} refuses service accounts since #1130, which left
their row-security attributes with no write path. Add an optional
attributes map to PUT /admin/service-accounts/{id} (UI-owned, editable
on BOOTSTRAP accounts), return it on the detail read, and add an
Attributes tab to the settings page with validation parity.
